descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S23 「添加 / 删除 / 重复提示的日志被记下，不带 PHI（Tim 的 api 测试）」 Add / remove / duplicate-prompt logging is recorded with no PHI (Tim's api tests)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 Silent, backend-only logging: every patient add tagged Scan or Manual, every patient removed or discharged, and every duplicate prompt as shown, accepted or rejected. …（TFA-92580 AC 7；TFA-92580 Analytics） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Backend-only (api project)

When Hospital: one manual add, a scan import with a retried request ID, and removals. Nursing Home: one manual add and one scan add. Duplicate prompts shown, accepted and rejected, including retries and impossible outcomes

Then patient_added rows are tagged manual or scan_census per context, and retries do not inflate the counts. Every Hospital removal is logged. Duplicate prompts log shown + outcome, never a name, MRN or diagnosis

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in api/patient-activity.spec.ts. Not covered by these tests: Nursing Home removal events, a 'discharged' event (Q11), whether the UI really sends the prompt events, and PHI absence on the patient_added / patient_removed rows (these are read back in S11, S12 and S29)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
